topic: Deploying latest mops build to analytics staging
summary_markdown: The conversation began with [me] noting that the analytics for both production and staging environments were down. A subsequent issue was also reported regarding an 'UPGRADE FAILED' status on a cube. Later, [me] requested assistance from someone to deploy the latest mops build from the develop branch onto the staging-analytics environment, as [me] lacked the necessary permissions.
decisions: Deploy the last mops build from develop to staging-analytics.
action_items: [p1] needs to deploy the latest mops build from develop to staging-analytics.
